text: [Image #2] xD idk whats happening but i have no head lmao
resolution: Fixed the missing head: it was dyn-mesh slot starvation. The figure preview path uses one DYN_SLOTS slot per body part (cap 48, shared with the editor's live 3D); 5 figures overran it and the player (rendered last) lost its head. Fix: NPCs no longer render as full figures — they render as their OWN rig hitboxes (solid faction-colored boxes, zero dyn slots, see-it==hit-it), and the player keeps the one full figure (the substrate's). Verified esbuild bundle clean.
